## Promotion checklist

All boxes must be ticked before this PR can merge.

- [ ] Test cases for this feature passed in the previous environment
- [ ] Affected areas are listed in the original PR description
- [ ] Automated tests added for this feature, or manual test evidence linked
- [ ] No open critical or high defects linked to this feature
- [ ] Test evidence attached (link or screenshot)
- [ ] Release notes / change description updated
- [ ] Rollback plan confirmed
